root_idea.summary: The root centers on softness, yieldingness, and ease of breaking or movement.
root_idea.development: From physical softness and friability, the lexicon extends to shaking or breaking foliage, and figuratively to lively, welcoming, responsive, or generous disposition, alongside specialized uses involving milk, thinness, and motion.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed under the normalized Form I perfect citation form هَشَّ rather than the attested first-person imperfect أَهُشُّ.

senses.definition: To beat or shake leaves or foliage with a staff so that they fall.
senses.usage_conditions: In the Quranic construction, the foliage is beaten or drawn toward the speaker with a staff so that the leaves fall for grazing animals; descriptions also include scattering the leaves toward oneself. This is a foliage-directed use, not merely a general sense of bringing something down.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become soft, yielding, lax, friable, or easily broken.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of things such as bread or wood. A reported figurative application to a person can evoke either an easy, compliant nature or weakness, depending on whether it is praise or disparagement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a tree, to shed its leaves one after another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An intransitive use describing leaves falling from the tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become weak, unable to endure hardship, languid, or aged.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative or assumed-tropical development of the basic Form I verb.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To be or become cheerful, lively, brisk, welcoming, or eager to do good.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With بِـ or إِلَى, the verb may describe cheerful conduct toward someone or eagerness for a beneficent act.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To incline toward someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The expression هَشِشْتُ إِلَى ٱمْرَأَتِي is reported with this interpretation, alongside the interpretation of being cheerful in disposition toward her.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A state of commotion or agitation among people.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Attested in the phrase هَشَاشُ القَوْمِ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To assault or strike with a staff or stick.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A broader staff-directed use, distinct from beating foliage so that its leaves fall.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To break dry herbage or the like into pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive use with dry vegetation or comparable brittle material.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To deem someone weak or feeble, or soft or gentle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive Form II evaluation of a person or thing.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To make someone or something brisk, lively, joyful, or happy; to incite it to such activity.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive causative use, including exciting or stimulating someone or something to liveliness.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become cheerful, lively, brisk, or sprightly.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form VIII, explicitly cross-referenced with the corresponding cheerful disposition of Form I.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To move or set in motion someone or something, or throw it into commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A transitive reduplicated form describing induced movement or agitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Softness, yieldingness, laxity, friability, or ease of breaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of bread, wood, dough, fruit, and similar things. In the figurative phrase هُوَ هَشٌّ المَكْسِرِ, the image of weak wood may praise compliance or disparage weakness; a reported contrary application describes baked dough or citron as dry or hard, apparently with emphasis on ease of breaking.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Easy or compliant when asked, or glad to be asked.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative description of a person’s disposition toward requests, especially requests for needed things.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Cheerful, lively, pleasant, or prompt to do good; of a horse, light of rein.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied in the cited expressions to a person or, in one use, to a lively horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, inclined to sweat much.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized equine use, contrasted with a horse that does not readily sweat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A ewe or she-goat abundant in milk.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A description of a female sheep or goat with a plentiful milk supply.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Dry herbage.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Recorded synonymously with هَشِيمٌ, with a particular regional application also reported.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A man niggardly with food toward his family or others.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative, assumed-tropical application concerning provision of food.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Leaves, apparently leaves beaten from a tree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A tentative lexical report; the leaves are understood as those produced by beating a tree.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A water-skin that leaks because its thinness lets water flow through.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized description of a thin, permeable water-skin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Motion or commotion.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A verbal noun describing movement or agitation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Good in disposition, liberal, or bountiful.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative character description.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A woman who displays love toward her husband and rejoices in him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized feminine description of affectionate marital behavior.
